---
title: "Add or change a staff member"
subtitle: "SOP MGR-09 · Manager manual"
---

## Purpose

Keep the staff list right: add someone who starts work, put a name or email
right, change a role, and mark someone who leaves as no longer working here.

## Applies to

Managers only. Nobody is ever deleted from the staff list: someone who leaves
is marked as no longer working here, and their name stays on every past groom
and record.

## Before you begin

- Admin is open. See [MGR-02 Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd).
- For a new staff member: you have their name as it should show on the
  Welcome screen, and their email.

## Procedure

1. On the Admin overview, under **The shop**, click the **Staff working here**
   card. The **Staff** list opens. Everyone who works here is listed, each
   with their email and role, **Groomer** or **Manager**.

   ![The staff list](/screenshots/manager/staff-list.png)

### Add a staff member

2. Click **Add a staff member** at the top right of the **Staff** list. The
   **New staff member** form opens above the list.

   ![Adding a staff member](/screenshots/manager/staff-add.png)

3. Click **Name** and type their name as it should show on the Welcome
   screen.
4. Click **Email** and type their email.
5. Under **Role**, click **Groomer** or **Manager**. A manager can also open
   Admin.
6. Click **Add to the staff list**. The form closes, and the list shows the
   new staff member.

A new manager sets up their own passkey or PIN the first time they open Admin.
See **Set up how you open Admin** in [MGR-02 Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd). Until then, the list shows
**Admin not set up yet** under their name.

### Change a name, email or role

2. Click **Change** beside the staff member. A form opens under their name,
   with their name, email and role filled in.
3. Click the box to change and type the new name or email, or under **Role**,
   click **Groomer** or **Manager**.
4. Click **Save changes**. The form closes, and the list shows the change.

A manager who is made a groomer loses their passkeys and PIN. If they are
made a manager again later, they set up Admin again, as on their first day.

### Mark someone as no longer working here

2. Click **No longer works here** beside the staff member. A question opens
   under their name.
3. Read the question.
4. Click **Yes, they no longer work here**. The staff member moves to the
   **No longer working here** list below. Their name comes off the Welcome
   screen and the list of groomers a booking can go to.

To cancel instead, click **Cancel**.

### Mark someone as working here again

2. In the **No longer working here** list, below the **Staff** list, click
   **Working here again** beside the staff member. They move back to the
   **Staff** list, and their name shows on the Welcome screen again.

### Finish

5. Click **← Back to the overview** to return to the Admin overview.

## Result

The **Staff** list shows a line in green under the list, such as **Sam is on
the staff list.** Every change is recorded in the shop's audit log, with your
name, and what it was before and after.

## If something goes wrong

### Someone on the staff list already has that email

Another staff member, working here or not, already has this email. Check the
email. If the person worked here before, find them in the **No longer
working here** list and click **Working here again** instead of adding them
again.

### Type their email, like name@example.com

The email is missing or is not a complete email. Type the whole email, with
the **@** and the part after it.

### The shop must keep at least one manager

You tried to make the shop's only manager a groomer, or to mark them as no
longer working here. Without a manager, nobody can open Admin. Make someone
else a manager first, then make the change.

### Sam still has 2 grooms booked ahead

The message names the staff member and how many grooms are booked with them.
Their dogs would be booked with someone who is not coming in. Move each of
those grooms to another groomer, or cancel it, first. See [GRM-11 Change or
cancel a booking](../groomer/change-booking.qmd). Then mark them as no longer
working here again.

### 🔒 Admin is locked

Admin locked because its 30 minutes ran out, or because you changed your own
role to groomer or marked yourself as no longer working here. Open Admin
again (see [MGR-02 Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd)) if you are still a
manager.
